PageBlocks.Title: Description linked employer-employee data LEED annual
PageBlocks.Content: Annual linked employer-employee data (LEED) provides person-level statistics for the March year about New Zealanders’ interaction with the labour market and their sources of income.

PageBlocks.Title: Access data in Aotearoa Data Explorer – LEED annual
PageBlocks.Content:
Access data in Aotearoa Data Explorer 

Aotearoa Data Explorer – LEED annual provides this data.
How to use Aotearoa Data Explorer contains video tutorials and a user guide.
